description: This file defines the SubscriptionComplete event class, which represents the completion of all pages in a search subscription in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and overrides methods related to event handling.

classes.name: SubscriptionComplete
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a search subscription has completed all its pages, used within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionComplete instance with specified subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionComplete instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path associated with this event (empty in this case).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionComplete with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends additional JSON payload data; in this case, nothing to add.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
